title: Open some stable feature in Master + Engineering_mode instead of Dev + engineering_mode
symptom: Users request access to stable features like Autotune or AutoISF that are currently only available in the dev branch with engineering_mode, because they are afraid to use the dev branch and seek workarounds.
fix: The thread discusses making these features available in the master branch behind engineering_mode, but no concrete resolution is stated; a commit link is provided but no details.
evidence_quote: I think it would be very helpful to have Autotune in the master branch behind engineering mode for safety.
